authority_boundary.a8: physical doorway and neutral request only
authority_boundary.a0: active run, run/site identity, transition validation, save/return anchor and finalization
authority_boundary.a1: canonical geography and approved scene/socket placement

rules: A8 does not teleport the actor or claim that a transition succeeded; the A0 composition root owns scene change after validating physical movement and owner context.
A8 never writes a run record, finalizes a run, or changes world position persistently.
A0 rejects stale or mismatched run, phase, site instance, POI, world, actor path, or unrecognized fields.
A1 canonical map anchors and the return path remain unchanged; a local scene transition does not create a new POI.
